body.x: GoodTec will be participating inMIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11(Fri) # 52843) and will be exhibiting 'Smart Guard Plug'.

Founded in 2017, GoodTec is acompany that manufactures IoT electronic products and is committed todeveloping convenient, safe and human-oriented technologies. GoodTec's SmartGuard Plug is a new type of smart plug that improves the inconvenience of theexisting product that the user has to operate manually with the automaticcontrol function.

Existing plug-in products must beoperated by the user directly, and because they operate based on the app, theproduct may be difficult to control if the use of the mobile phone is not free.To solve this problem, GoodTec developed 'Smart Guard Plug' to enable anyone touse electronic products safely and easily.

The 'Smart Guard Plug' can beoperated directly without installing an app and can be controlled withBluetooth without additional equipment. It also has the advantage of preventingfire and power wastage through automatic power cut-off through Bluetooth. Thisproduct will be able to control the power automatically without any user'soperation, and it will be recognized through the CES.

GoodTec, which is participatingin the 2019 CES with the Daejeon Information Culture Industry Promotion Agency,expects to meet with Southeast Asia buyers and industry representatives fromEurope, America and emerging markets. GoodTec will upgrade the versionaccording to the usage direction of the product, and will also produce a 'SmartGuard Plug' that can be used by many people at the same time as aconsumer-oriented product. GoodTec is committed to expanding its market sharein export and domestic market by participating in various exhibitions at homeand abroad with such technology.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party. Also, on the third eveningof the exhibition, MIK NIGHT party, a business networking party, will be held.In addition, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT will be jointly planned and operated byAVING NEWS and GMEG, a global MICE specialist company.CES 2019 is an innovative exhibition where technologycompanies that will lead the fourth industrial revolution will participate.
